title: ArenaWaves
description: Simple wave arena with bossbar progress and vanilla mobs.
body:
# ArenaWaves

Simple wave arena with bossbar progress and vanilla mobs.

## Features
- Vanilla mob waves with configurable delays.
- Bossbar wave indicator.
- Join/leave system and admin start/stop.
- Randomized spawn positions in arena radius.

## Command
- `/arenawaves setarena | join | leave | start | stop | status | reload`

## Permissions
- `arenawaves.use`
- `arenawaves.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
bossbar.enabled: true
min-players: 1
waves.wave1.mobs:
  - ZOMBIE:8
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
